theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 20 群

items.colloc: arrange a meeting 安排會面 | arrange a date 敲定日期
items.distinct: organize a conference 組織會議 | host a conference 主辦會議
ex: We need to arrange a conference next month.
我們下個月需要籌備一場會議。
The secretary is busy arranging a conference.
秘書正忙於安排會議。
Please arrange a conference with the supplier.
請安排與供應商開會。

items.colloc: as opposed to others 與其他人相比 | as opposed to yesterday 與昨天相反
items.distinct: in contrast to 與…形成對比 | instead of 代替
ex: We focus on quality as opposed to quantity.
我們專注於品質而非數量。
The goal is growth as opposed to stability.
目標是成長而不是穩定。
Use the new software as opposed to the old one.
請使用新軟體而非舊的那套。

items.colloc: aside from that 除了那點之外 | aside from this 除了這點之外
items.distinct: besides 除了…還有（包含） | except for 除了…之外（排除）
ex: Aside from the cost, the plan is perfect.
除了成本之外，這項計畫很完美。
Aside from these tasks, I have other duties.
除了這些任務，我還有其他職責。
We are done aside from the final report.
除了最後的報告，我們都完成了。

items.colloc: work at full speed 全力工作 | run at full speed 全速奔跑
items.distinct: at high speed 高速地 | at a fast pace 快節奏地
ex: The factory is operating at full speed.
工廠目前正全速運作。
We are working at full speed to meet deadlines.
我們正全力趕工以達成期限。
Production must run at full speed this quarter.
這季的生產必須全速運作。

items.colloc: the public at large 一般大眾 | society at large 整個社會
items.distinct: in general 一般而言 | on the whole 整體來說
ex: This issue affects the public at large.
這個議題影響了一般大眾。
The decision was supported by society at large.
該決策得到了整個社會的支持。
We must consider the concerns of the community at large.
我們必須考慮整個社區的顧慮。

items.pos: phr. 免費；無需額外費用
items.colloc: provide at no extra charge 免費提供 | included at no extra charge 免費包含
items.distinct: free of charge 免費 | at no cost 免費
ex: We provide delivery at no extra charge.
我們提供免費配送服務。
Maintenance is included at no extra charge.
保養服務已免費包含在內。
The update is available at no extra charge.
此更新無需額外費用即可取得。

items.pos: phr. 接待客戶；服務客戶
items.zh: 接待客戶；處理客戶事務
items.colloc: attend to a customer 接待顧客 | attend to needs 處理需求
items.distinct: serve a client 服務客戶 | assist a client 協助客戶
ex: He is attending to a client in the office.
他正在辦公室接待客戶。
Staff should attend to a client immediately.
員工應立即接待客戶。
She knows how to attend to a client properly.
她知道如何妥善服務客戶。

items.pos: phr. 急於做某事；渴望做某事
items.zh: 急於做某事；渴望做某事
items.colloc: be anxious to learn 急於學習 | be anxious to start 急於開始
items.distinct: be eager to do 渴望做… | be keen to do 熱衷於做…
ex: Management is anxious to do something about it.
管理層急於針對此事採取行動。
I am anxious to do well in the interview.
我渴望在面試中有好表現。
They are anxious to do business with us.
他們急於與我們做生意。

items.colloc: remain closed to the public 持續不對外開放 | temporarily closed to the public 暫時不對外開放
items.distinct: private 私人的 | restricted access 限制進入
ex: The building is closed to the public today.
該大樓今天不對外開放。
That area is permanently closed to the public.
那個區域永久不對外開放。
The gallery is closed to the public for repairs.
畫廊因維修而不對外開放。

items.colloc: the machine broke down 機器故障 | the negotiation broke down 談判破裂
items.distinct: malfunction 失靈；故障 | fail 失敗；故障
ex: The printer broke down during the meeting.
會議期間印表機故障了。
Talks broke down over the pricing issue.
談判因價格問題而破裂。
Our delivery truck broke down this morning.
我們的貨車今天早上故障了。

items.pos: phr. 被設計用來做某事
items.colloc: be designed to improve 旨在改善 | be designed to help 旨在協助
items.distinct: be intended for 意圖用於 | be meant to do 旨在做…
ex: This software is designed to save time.
這款軟體旨在節省時間。
The new policy is designed to motivate staff.
新政策旨在激勵員工。
Our products are designed to meet high standards.
我們的產品旨在符合高標準。

items.pos: phr. 針對；適合；調整以適應
items.colloc: be geared to needs 針對需求調整 | be geared to users 針對用戶設計
items.distinct: be aimed at 針對… | be tailored to 為…量身打造
ex: The program is geared to young professionals.
該計畫是針對年輕專業人士設計的。
Our services are geared to client success.
我們的服務旨在促進客戶成功。
The campaign is geared to global markets.
這項活動是針對全球市場進行調整。

items.colloc: be of interest to users 對用戶有吸引力 | be of interest to us 對我們有意義
items.distinct: be interested in 對…感興趣 | attract the interest of 吸引…的興趣
ex: This report will be of particular interest to you.
這份報告會讓你特別感興趣。
The results are of particular interest to management.
這些結果讓管理層特別感興趣。
These findings are of particular interest to researchers.
這些發現讓研究人員特別感興趣。

items.colloc: be on a business trip 出差中 | be on a trip abroad 在國外旅行
items.distinct: go on a trip 去旅行 | take a trip 去旅行
ex: The manager is on a trip this week.
經理這週出差不在。
She is currently on a trip for the company.
她目前正在為公司出差。
I will be on a trip until Friday.
我會出差到週五。

items.colloc: busy on another call 正忙於另一個電話 | stay on another call 繼續另一通電話
items.distinct: be on the phone 在講電話 | be unavailable 接聽不了
ex: He is on another call at the moment.
他此刻正在通話中。
The customer is on another call right now.
客戶目前正在另一通電話上。
Please wait as she is on another call.
請稍候，她正在通話中。

items.colloc: be sensitive to change 對變化敏感 | be sensitive to needs 體貼需求
items.distinct: be aware of 意識到 | be responsive to 對…有回應
ex: The team is sensitive to market trends.
團隊對市場趨勢很敏感。
Be sensitive to the needs of the client.
請體貼客戶的需求。
He is sensitive to price changes.
他對價格變動很敏感。

items.colloc: be shaded by trees 被樹木遮蔽 | stay in the shaded area 待在陰涼處
items.distinct: be in the shade 在陰影中 | be shadowed 被投下陰影
ex: The garden should be shaded by noon.
花園中午時應該會有遮蔭。
The patio is shaded during the summer.
露台在夏天有遮蔭。
Our desks are shaded from the sun.
我們的辦公桌避開了陽光直射。

items.pos: phr. 應該做某事；被期望做某事
items.zh: 應該做某事；被期望做某事
items.colloc: be supposed to finish 應該完成 | be supposed to arrive 應該抵達
items.distinct: ought to do 應該做 | be expected to do 被期望做
ex: We are supposed to submit the report today.
我們應該要在今天提交報告。
The meeting was supposed to start at ten.
會議原本應該在十點開始。
You are supposed to follow the rules.
你應該遵守規定。

items.colloc: be surrounded by greenery 被綠意包圍 | be surrounded by experts 被專家環繞
items.distinct: surround with 用…圍繞 | be enclosed by 被…封閉
ex: The office is surrounded by many shops.
辦公室周圍有很多商店。
We are surrounded by talented colleagues.
我們被有才華的同事所環繞。
The building is surrounded by a fence.
這棟建築物被圍欄包圍著。

items.colloc: stay up late 熬夜 | work up late 深夜工作
items.distinct: stay awake 保持清醒 | work overtime 加班
ex: I had to be up late to finish it.
我不得不熬夜把它完成。
Do not be up late before the presentation.
簡報前不要熬夜。
He was up late working on the project.
他為了那個專案熬夜工作。
